selection: Greedy adjacent complete lexical event clusters,10-30s,at least2 speakers,no reference overlap; flush at overlap/unclear event or gaps>3s. Annotation boundaries are training supervision only; existing validation/final inputs and scoring remain unchanged.
references: Original complete AMI word XML and frozen count-validated AISHELL TextGrid reader. Empty/nonlexical/unclear labels are retained in source metadata; unclear intervals exclude a training window instead of inventing words.
wordHandling: All selected original words, fillers, repetitions, partial words and numbers kept. English words separated by spaces; Chinese labels concatenated without lexical normalization.
trainingFormat: Official Qwen audio/text JSONL,language prefix. No model trained by export; raw full source events retained for later overlap/person supervision.
